description: This file defines an abstract class ContentPage that extends SimplePage, representing a content page in a documentation generation context. It manages content, configuration, and content type, and provides methods for initializing and generating page content based on associated files and content types.

classes.name: ContentPage
classes.description: An abstract class representing a content page that handles content conversion, configuration, and file association within a documentation system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the page with a title and content, invoking the page initialization.

methods.name: setFile
methods.description: Associates a file object (Content) with this page.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets the configuration object for the page.

methods.name: setParams
methods.description: Deprecated method to set configuration, now redirects to setConfig.

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Sets the content type for this page.

methods.name: getPureContent
methods.description: Returns the converted content, generating it if necessary based on the content type.

methods.name: generatePage
methods.description: Generates the page content; currently returns the pure content.

methods.name: fromFile
methods.description: Creates a ContentPage instance from a file, configuration, and content type.
